```{r}
# Libraries Used:
library(lars)
library(caret) 
library(MASS)  
library(glmnet)
library(randomForest)
```

```{r}
# Loading the dataset
data(diabetes)

# Fixing issue with lars package diabetes dataset format
# Forcing every column to be a standard numeric vector
temp_x <- as.matrix(diabetes$x)

diabetes_df <- data.frame(
  age = as.numeric(temp_x[, "age"]),
  sex = as.numeric(temp_x[, "sex"]),
  bmi = as.numeric(temp_x[, "bmi"]),
  map = as.numeric(temp_x[, "map"]),
  tc  = as.numeric(temp_x[, "tc"]),
  ldl = as.numeric(temp_x[, "ldl"]),
  hdl = as.numeric(temp_x[, "hdl"]),
  tch = as.numeric(temp_x[, "tch"]),
  ltg = as.numeric(temp_x[, "ltg"]),
  glu = as.numeric(temp_x[, "glu"])
)

# Attach the response variable as a standard numeric vector
diabetes_df$progression <- as.numeric(diabetes$y)

# Train/Test Split (80/20 split)
set.seed(4052) 
train_index <- createDataPartition(diabetes_df$progression, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
train_data <- diabetes_df[train_index, ]
test_data  <- diabetes_df[-train_index, ]
```

```{r}
# Fitting a full multiple linear regression model using the training data
baseline_model <- lm(progression ~ ., data = train_data)

# Run the Box-Cox transformation
# Lambda from -2 to 2 for now
bc <- boxcox(baseline_model, lambda = seq(-2, 2, by = 0.1))

# Find and print the exact lambda that maximizes the log-likelihood
optimal_lambda <- bc$x[which.max(bc$y)]
print(paste("Optimal Lambda:", optimal_lambda))
```

```{r}
# Sqrt Box-Cox Transformation (lambda ~= 0.5)
train_data$progression_sqrt <- sqrt(train_data$progression)
test_data$progression_sqrt <- sqrt(test_data$progression)

# Cleaning datasets: Remove the original 'progression' variable
train_data_clean <- train_data
train_data_clean$progression <- NULL

test_data_clean <- test_data
test_data_clean$progression <- NULL
```

```{r}
# Model 1: Multiple Linear Regression
model_mlr <- lm(progression_sqrt ~ ., data = train_data_clean)

# Model 2: Lasso Regression
# matrix formatting for glmnet
x_train <- as.matrix(train_data_clean[, -which(names(train_data_clean) == "progression_sqrt")])
y_train <- train_data_clean$progression_sqrt
x_test  <- as.matrix(test_data_clean[, -which(names(test_data_clean) == "progression_sqrt")])
y_test  <- test_data_clean$progression_sqrt

# Cross-validation for optimal lambda
set.seed(4052)
cv_lasso <- cv.glmnet(x_train, y_train, alpha = 1)
best_lambda <- cv_lasso$lambda.min
model_lasso <- glmnet(x_train, y_train, alpha = 1, lambda = best_lambda)

# Model 3: Random Forest
set.seed(4052)
model_rf <- randomForest(progression_sqrt ~ ., data = train_data_clean, importance = TRUE)

# Evaluation on held-out test set
pred_mlr   <- predict(model_mlr, newdata = test_data_clean)
pred_lasso <- predict(model_lasso, s = best_lambda, newx = x_test)
pred_rf    <- predict(model_rf, newdata = test_data_clean)

rmse_mlr   <- sqrt(mean((pred_mlr - y_test)^2))
rmse_lasso <- sqrt(mean((pred_lasso - y_test)^2))
rmse_rf    <- sqrt(mean((pred_rf - y_test)^2))

print(paste("MLR RMSE:", round(rmse_mlr, 3)))
print(paste("Lasso RMSE:", round(rmse_lasso, 3)))
print(paste("Random Forest RMSE:", round(rmse_rf, 3)))
```

```{r}
# Lasso Evaluation
# Calculate the Total Sum of Squares (TSS) for the test set
# Total variance in the true test data
mean_y_test <- mean(y_test)
tss <- sum((y_test - mean_y_test)^2)

# Residual Sum of Squares (RSS)
rss_lasso <- sum((pred_lasso - y_test)^2)

# Test R-squared
r_squared_lasso <- 1 - (rss_lasso / tss)

# Mean Absolute Error (MAE)
mae_lasso <- mean(abs(pred_lasso - y_test))

# MLR Evaluation
rss_mlr <- sum((pred_mlr - y_test)^2)
r_squared_mlr <- 1 - (rss_mlr / tss)
mae_mlr <- mean(abs(pred_mlr - y_test))

# Random Forest Evaluation
rss_rf <- sum((pred_rf - y_test)^2)
r_squared_rf <- 1 - (rss_rf / tss)
mae_rf <- mean(abs(pred_rf - y_test))

print(paste("Lasso Test R-squared:", round(r_squared_lasso, 3)))
print(paste("Lasso Test MAE:", round(mae_lasso, 3)))
print(paste("MLR Test R-squared:", round(r_squared_mlr, 3)))
print(paste("MLR Test MAE:", round(mae_mlr, 3)))
print(paste("RF Test R-squared:", round(r_squared_rf, 3)))
print(paste("RF Test MAE:", round(mae_rf, 3)))
```

```{r}
#Result Visualizations

# Plot 1: Lasso Cross-Validation Curve
# This shows how the model tuned the penalty parameter (lambda)

# Fixing top margin for formatting
par(mar = c(5.1, 4.1, 6.1, 2.1))

plot(cv_lasso)

title("Lasso Cross-Validation Error Curve", line = 4)

par(mar = c(5.1, 4.1, 4.1, 2.1))

# Plot 2: Random Forest Variable Importance
# This shows which predictors were most useful in reducing error
varImpPlot(model_rf, main = "Random Forest Variable Importance")
```
